preview.what: Promises and async/await, error handling, and cancelling requests.
preview.picture: A restaurant buzzer: you get the buzzer now (promise), food later (resolution). await is waiting at the counter without blocking other customers. AbortController is walking away and telling the kitchen to stop.
preview.why: Unhandled rejections and sequential-vs-parallel awaits are common live-coding traps.
preview.bn: Promise = বাজার, await = কাউন্টারে দাঁড়ানো কিন্তু অন্যদের আটকানো না, AbortController = 'থামো'।
